app.name: Knowledge graph console
nav.label: Pages
ask.title: Ask
ask.lede: Ask the knowledge graph a question. Every answer lists the sources it read, and each source leads back to its passage and its place in the graph.
ask.question: Question
ask.placeholder: Ask about the indexed documents. Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line.
ask.followUp: Treat as a follow-up (keeps the conversation)
ask.filtersHelp: One key: value per line. A key the index does not declare is refused before any model call.
ask.samples: Try a question about this corpus
ask.emptyNamespace: Ingest a corpus into this namespace, then ask about it here.
ask.retrieving: Searching the graph and the documents…
ask.evidenceNoneBody: The question ended without an answer, so no source was read.
ask.evidenceEmpty: When an answer arrives, its sources appear here in the order the answer model read them. Open one to follow its trail.
ask.routing.router: Auto chose {{strategy}}: the router picked it from {{candidates}}.
ask.routing.only_candidate: Auto used {{strategy}}: it is the only strategy that applies these filters to this index.
ask.routing.fallback: Auto fell back to {{strategy}}: the router did not name a strategy it could use.
ask.abstention.no_context: Retrieval found no context for this question, so no model was asked to answer it.
ask.abstention.marker: The answer model said the context does not answer the question.
ask.abstention.insufficient_context: The strategy judged its context insufficient, and the policy is to decline in that case.
ask.blocked: The guardrail blocked this question or its answer
ask.degraded: The query failed and returned the fallback answer
ask.partialHelp: The answer was given without some steps that failed: {{steps}}. It may miss what they would have found.
ask.unresolvedHelp: The documents of some sources could not be read ({{steps}}), so the sources name fewer documents than the answer rests on. The answer itself is complete.
ask.error.not_indexed: This index does not hold what the strategy reads
ask.error.index_not_found: This namespace has no index yet: ingest a corpus into it first
ask.error.timeout: The query ran past its deadline
ask.error.store_unreachable: A store could not be reached
ask.error.model_unreachable: A model server could not be reached: start it, or check its base_url
ask.error.invalid_argument: The request was refused: an argument to change
ask.error.configuration: The configuration cannot serve this query
ask.meta.tokensHelp: Input and output tokens of every model call this answer made
ask.trace.noSources: The answer model was given no context for this question.
ask.cite.open: Open source [{{marker}}] in the provenance trail: {{source}}
ask.cite.unknown: [{{marker}}] is not a section of this answer's context
ask.citations.title: Cited in this answer
ask.citations.summary: a summary the model read, not a listed source
ask.trace.markerCited: Context marker [{{marker}}], cited by the answer
ask.trail.citedByNone: No entity or relationship in this answer cites it
ask.trail.statedInNone: None of its passages was in this answer's context
ask.trail.unread_one: and {{count}} passage the answer did not read
ask.trail.unread_other: and {{count}} passages the answer did not read
strategy.label: Search strategy
strategy.unavailable_one: {{count}} strategy is not available on this index
strategy.unavailable_other: {{count}} strategies are not available on this index
strategy.help.auto: An LLM router picks a strategy for each question.
strategy.help.local: Questions about specific entities: follows their relationships in the graph.
strategy.help.global: Broad questions about themes: reads the community reports.
strategy.help.drift: Multi-part questions: reports draft follow-ups that each run a local search. The most model calls.
strategy.help.simple: Fast factual lookups over the documents, without the graph.
strategy.help.mix: General LightRAG search: keywords to entities and relationships, plus passages.
strategy.help.hybrid: Keyword-driven graph questions: mix without the passage search.
strategy.help.naive: Passages only: a fast baseline to compare against.
strategy.help.iterative: Chains facts across rounds: follows the bridge entities a fast model names.
strategy.help.ppr: Multi-hop facts by Personalized PageRank: one model call, low cost.
strategy.help.tree: Searches the summary tree: passages and every level of their summaries.
strategy.help.structured: Counting, ranking and filtering questions: a planned graph query the store runs, falling back to local.
methodology.help.graphrag: Communities and their reports, for local, global and drift.
methodology.help.lightrag: Relationship vectors, for mix, hybrid and naive.
methodology.help.hipporag: The graph and its passages, for ppr; no community reports.
methodology.help.raptor: A summary tree over the passages, for tree.
ingest.title: Ingest
ingest.lede: Build or update the index from a folder of documents. A run reads the files, extracts the graph and writes the stores.
ingest.ledeIncremental: Run it again after the files change and only new or changed documents are processed.
ingest.noCorpora: No document folders in the workspace
ingest.noCorporaHelp: Upload a folder below, or add one to the workspace directory the console was started with.
ingest.unsupported_one: {{count}} file of another type is skipped
ingest.unsupported_other: {{count}} files of other types are skipped
ingest.uploadHelp: Pick a folder or files. Supported: {{extensions}}. They are copied into the workspace's uploads folder.
ingest.methodologiesHelp: Build only the methodologies you will query: each one adds its own index artifacts and model calls. Adding one later builds only what it needs.
ingest.indexValueHelp: Write into another namespace (the index suffix). Empty uses the configured one.
ingest.forceRebuildHelp: Ignores the cached stage outputs and asks the models again. Costs a full run.
ingest.confirmResetHelp: Answers yes if the run must drop another source's content to rebuild.
ingest.confirmDeletionsHelp: Answers yes if the run would delete more documents than the configured share.
ingest.narrowingHelp: The namespace {{namespace}} holds {{methodologies}}, which this run does not build. Building fewer methodologies removes them from the namespace: their strategies stop answering for every corpus in it, not only this one.
ingest.oneAtATime: One run at a time: wait for the current one or stop it.
ingest.noRun: Choose a corpus and start a run. Its stages appear here as they finish.
ingest.noHistoryHelp: Runs you start on this page are listed here. Open one to see its stages again.
job.interleavedHelp: Interleaved runs are scored and saved only once every answer is in: stopping now keeps none of them.
job.stoppedIngest: The finished stages are kept. Start the same corpus again to resume from the stage that was running.
job.stoppedEvaluate: The runs that finished are saved; the one in progress is not.
job.stoppedInterleaved: No run was saved: an interleaved evaluation saves its runs only once every answer is in. Start it again to answer them all.
job.failedNoMessage: It ended without an error message; see the log.
evaluate.title: Evaluate
evaluate.lede: Answer a dataset with several strategies, repeat it, and compare them question by question, with confidence intervals and the cost of each.
evaluate.datasetHelp: A run-eval JSON file in the workspace: a list of questions, with answers, reference sources or expected entities for the evaluators that need them.
evaluate.noDatasetsHelp: Add a JSON list of questions to the workspace (see the evaluation guide for the format).
evaluate.feedsNone: No question has answers or references: only judges that need none can score it.
evaluate.strategiesHelp: The first is the baseline the others are compared with.
evaluate.closedBookHelp: Also answers with the model alone, no retrieval: a bound on what it knows without the corpus.
evaluate.pairwiseHelp: An LLM compares each strategy's answers with the baseline's, per answer-length bucket. Adds a model call per pair.
evaluate.gatesHelp: One per line, MEASURE:STAT<OP>VALUE. The run fails when a strategy's paired delta meets one.
evaluate.noRun: Start one to see its runs finish here. Saved runs are listed below.
evaluate.noSaved: No saved runs in the evaluation outputs.
evaluate.noSavedHelp: An evaluation you start above is saved here when it finishes. Open it to compare its strategies.
evaluate.noDirection: Neither higher nor lower is better
evaluate.questionsShow: Show each question’s {{metric}} and the answers
evaluate.questionsHelp: Each strategy’s score on the primary metric, the mean over its repeats; the outcome compares {{candidate}} with {{baseline}}. Open a question to read the answers side by side.
evaluate.questionsNone: This run saved no per-question results (evaluation.save_detailed_results).
evaluate.question: Question
evaluate.pairedHelp: Each question's mean over its repeats, paired across the two strategies; intervals from {{resamples}} bootstrap resamples.
evaluate.pairedHolmHelp: A difference counts when its Holm-adjusted p-value is below {{alpha}}. The primary metric, the other metrics and the costs are each adjusted as a family, so reading many rows does not turn noise into differences; the intervals are each family's simultaneous ones, for the size of a difference.
evaluate.pairedPlainHelp: A difference whose interval crosses zero is not one. These intervals are not adjusted for comparing many metrics at once.
evaluate.armRoleHelp.closed_book: This run answered without retrieval (the answer model alone): its deltas bound what the model knows without the corpus, not a finding. They are left out of the Holm adjustment and the gates, and none is marked better or worse.
evaluate.armRoleHelp.aa: This run is the base configuration again (an A/A arm): its deltas are the noise floor of each metric, not a finding. They are left out of the Holm adjustment and the gates, and none is marked better or worse.
evaluate.warnings: Read these before trusting the comparison
evaluate.noComparisonHelp: A comparison is saved when a run has two or more strategies, repeats, or a baseline.
evaluate.abstentionHelp: Precision and recall need questions marked unanswerable: how many declines were on them, and how many of them were declined.
evaluate.lengthsNone: Run with the pairwise judge to see win rates by answer length.
chart.deltaCaption: Paired differences against the baseline, with {{confidence}} intervals
chart.deltaCaptionHolm: Paired differences against the baseline, Holm-adjusted at alpha {{alpha}}, with each family's simultaneous intervals
chart.primaryHelp: The metric declared in advance (evaluation.primary_metric), tested apart from the others
metric.answer_correctness: LLM judge (ragas): how correct the answer is against the reference.
metric.answer_relevancy: LLM judge (ragas): how relevant the answer is to the question.
metric.context_precision: LLM judge (ragas): share of the retrieved context that is relevant.
metric.context_recall: LLM judge (ragas): share of the reference the retrieved context covers.
metric.correctness: LLM judge of the removed langchain evaluator: answer correctness.
metric.faithfulness: LLM judge (ragas): share of the answer's claims the context supports.
metric.partial_correctness: LLM judge of the removed langchain evaluator: partial correctness.
metric.entity_coverage: Share of the expected entities the answer names.
metric.relationship_coverage: Share of the expected relationships the answer states.
metric.retrieved_entity_coverage: Share of the expected entities among the sources the answer model read.
metric.retrieved_relationship_coverage: Share of the expected relationships among the sources the answer model read.
metric.answer_length: Answer length in characters, next to the coverage metrics (which rise with it).
metric.hit_at_k: 1 when a reference file is among the top k files of the reported sources.
metric.recall_at_k: Share of the reference files among the top k files of the reported sources.
metric.mrr: Reciprocal rank of the first reference file among the reported sources.
metric.attributable_fraction: Share of the reported sources attributable to a file: how much of the context the rank metrics see.
metric.citation_precision: Share of the answer's citations that name a reference file.
metric.citation_recall: Share of the reference files a citation of the answer names.
metric.citation_precision_passages: Citation precision over the cited passages only.
metric.exact_match: 1 when the answer equals the reference or an alias (normalized).
metric.token_f1: Token overlap (F1) between the answer and the reference or its best alias.
metric.answer_contains: 1 when the answer contains the reference or an alias.
metric.assertion_recall: LLM judge: share of the positive assertions the answer supports.
metric.assertion_contradiction_rate: LLM judge: share of the positive assertions the answer contradicts.
metric.negative_assertion_violation_rate: LLM judge: share of the negative assertions the answer states.
metric.abstention_recall: Share of the unanswerable questions whose answer declined.
metric.abstention_precision: Share of the declined answers that were to unanswerable questions.
graph.title: Graph
graph.lede: Explore the graph the last ingestion exported: search an entity, open its neighbourhood, compare communities, and see how much of it a schema or a seed graph states.
graph.none: An ingestion run exports the graph after community detection. Run one, then come back.
graph.noMatch: No entity has that in its name.
graph.canvasLabel: Graph of {{nodes}} entities and {{edges}} relationships. Arrow keys pan, plus and minus zoom, Escape clears the selection.
graph.drawnOnly: The {{drawn}} best-connected of {{total}} entities are drawn; find the others by name or in the table below.
graph.notDrawn: Not drawn on the canvas: only the best-connected entities are.
graph.pickHint: Select an entity in the graph, or find one by name.
graph.noCommunities: This export holds no communities (a run without GraphRAG).
graph.name: Name
graph.trail.question: From your question “{{question}}”
dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.lede: What the questions asked here and the jobs run here took: time, tokens and cost, per strategy, model and role.
dashboard.empty: The dashboard counts the questions asked and the jobs run through this console.
dashboard.noPrices: Add the models' prices under evaluation.prices in Settings to see costs in USD; until then the dashboard counts tokens only.
dashboard.unpriced: Not priced: {{models}}. Costs leave them out.
dashboard.name: Name
dashboard.clearHelp: Deletes the recorded questions from this console's store. Jobs and their results stay.
dashboard.clearConfirm: Delete every recorded question? This cannot be undone.
settings.title: Settings
settings.lede: Edits {{path}}. Every change is checked as a run would load it and shown as a diff before it is written.
settings.ledeNoFile: The console was started without a configuration file: it runs on the defaults, and nothing can be saved. Start it with --config-path to edit one.
settings.credentials: {{keys}}: the console does not show or write secrets, so this file can only be edited elsewhere. Move them to environment variables to edit it here.
settings.savedHelp: The next question and job use the new settings.
settings.credentialField: A secret: set it with an environment variable, never here.
settings.errors.json: Enter valid JSON (a list, an object, a quoted string).
settings.yamlHidden: The file holds secrets, so its text is not shown.
settings.yamlHelp: Saving the text keeps its comments.
settings.effectiveHelp: The configuration a run gets: the file over the defaults, with the UKR__ environment variables applied. Secrets are masked.
settings.noChanges: No changes yet. Edit a field, or the YAML.
settings.valid: Loads as a run would load it
settings.commentsDropped: Saving from fields rewrites the file without its comments. Edit the YAML tab to keep them.
settings.methodologiesHelp: indexing.methodologies: what an ingestion builds. Queries refuse a strategy whose methodology the index does not hold.
settings.methodologyRebuild: Adding a methodology makes the next ingestion build only its artifacts; removing one stops building it, and its strategies are refused.
settings.observabilityHelp: Traces of queries and ingestion runs, through OpenTelemetry to Langfuse, Phoenix or any OTLP endpoint. Endpoints and keys come from environment variables, never from this file.
settings.otelMissing: Tracing needs the otel extra: uv sync --extra otel.
settings.captureContent: Record prompts and answers on spans
settings.captureContentHelp: Off by default; leave it off for confidential documents.
settings.environmentHelp: Whether each variable is set in the console's environment; values are never shown. Set them before starting the console.
evaluate.baselineIs: {{strategy}} is the baseline: the first chosen. The others are compared with it.
ask.incomplete: The answer stream ended before its result. Ask again.
ingest.confirmIntegrityHelp: Answers yes if the corpus or the settings changed since this corpus's last run: the stages they touch run again.
ingest.question.integrity: The corpus changed since its last run
ingest.question.integrityHelp: The stages the change touches run again; what did not change is kept.
ingest.question.resetHelp: It would drop another source's content to rebuild the index.
ingest.question.deletions: The run would delete many documents
ingest.question.deletionsHelp: Their files are gone from the corpus, more than the configured share.
settings.endpointsTitle: This change sends requests to another address
settings.endpointsConfirm: Send them there, with the credentials this console's environment holds for them
settings.directoriesTitle: This change moves a file or folder the console uses
settings.directoriesHelp: The console serves evaluation outputs and exported graphs from these paths, and its jobs read and write the stores, logs, schema and seed files and parsing folders at them: anyone with this console's address can then reach what is there.
error.unauthorized: Open the address run-console printed: it carries the access token.
error.foreign_host: Refused: the console answers only on its own address.
error.credential_refused: Not saved: the console keeps secrets out of files.
error.endpoints: Not saved: confirm the new endpoints first.
error.directories: Not saved: confirm the moved folders first.
error.job_conflict: Another job runs in this namespace.
error.narrowing: Not started: confirm the methodologies the run removes first.
error.upload_conflict: Not uploaded: a file and a folder share a name.
error.network: The console does not answer. Is run-console still running?
